scope: native DDP implementation admission and checkpoint continuation on CPU/Gloo

full_unit_suite.selection: tests/unit -m 'not performance and not slow and not gpu'

Dependency installation metadata is captured once per process; restart workers after dependency changes.
Local numerical contracts do not certify model quality, dataset review, provider conformance, or long-running reliability.
